description: This file defines a Printer struct and associated functions for formatted output, including support for JSON and plain text, with features like paging, templates, and error handling, used in the Mattermost CLI.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: A struct for managing formatted output, including options for format, paging, templates, and error lines.

methods.name: linesToBytes
methods.description: Converts accumulated lines to byte array, supporting JSON and plain formats, with optional single or multiple line output.

methods.name: printBytes
methods.description: Outputs byte data to the writer, optionally through a pager if enabled.

methods.name: printErrors
methods.description: Prints accumulated error lines to stderr.
